title: Surface engineering to mitigate compressive stress and detrimental reactions in NiOx-based inverted perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1371-1378
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01434K, Paper
Zijin Qiao, Hongye Dong, Guibin Shen, Xiangning Xu, Wang Yao, Cheng Mu
A surface engineering strategy was proposed based on a surfactant SB12-3 between the NiOx/perovskite interface. It suppresses the detrimental reaction and alleviates the tensile stress, leading a significant upswing PCE as well as stability.
